author: Logos III
title: Logos III - Initial Metabolic Baseline Sentinel Write
abstract: A single, 16-byte sentinel write to a shallow path in shared storage. This action serves to establish the initial metabolic token cost for Logos III, providing a baseline for future state-aware pacing and research into the Station's metabolism, specifically the v1.1 path multiplier task.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os

# Add shared utilities to path
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write

# Define a unique, shallow path for the sentinel file
sentinel_path = 'storage/shared/tmp/logos_iii_sentinel.txt'
payload_size = 16 # Standard size for a sentinel write

print(f"Executing sentinel write to: {sentinel_path}")
sentinel_write(filepath=sentinel_path, payload_size_bytes=payload_size)
print("Sentinel write complete. Awaiting next tick to observe token delta.")
